description: Common variable modifications the variable-modification editor offers in one step (R-PARAM-09). Each mass difference is the monoisotopic delta of the cited Unimod record (fetched 2026-10-05); each tuple's other fields follow the cited Comet documentation. A preset is offered for a release only where a slot of that release can hold it. Documented in docs/developer/comet_parameter_schema.rst, section 'Common-modification presets'.

presets.name: Oxidation
presets.description: Oxidation of methionine (M), up to three per peptide, optional.
presets.massSource: https://www.unimod.org/modifications_view.php?editid1=35 -- Unimod 35, Oxidation: monoisotopic 15.994915; site M, position Anywhere
presets.formSource: https://uwpr.github.io/Comet/parameters/parameters_202602/variable_modXX.html -- the page's first example, variable_mod01 = 15.9949 M 0 3 -1 0 0 0.0, which is also comet -q's own variable_mod01; the precise mass is Unimod's

presets.name: Phospho
presets.description: Phosphorylation of serine, threonine and tyrosine (S, T, Y), up to three per peptide, optional, no neutral loss.
presets.massSource: https://www.unimod.org/modifications_view.php?editid1=21 -- Unimod 21, Phospho: monoisotopic 79.966331; sites S, T and Y, position Anywhere
presets.formSource: https://uwpr.github.io/Comet/parameters/parameters_202602/variable_modXX.html -- the page's example variable_mod02 = 79.966331 STY 0 3 -1 0 0 97.976896, here without the neutral loss (eighth field 0.0, 'not zero' enables one)

presets.name: Acetyl
presets.description: Acetylation of the protein N-terminus, written as Comet 2026.02.2 writes it: n at distance 0 from the protein N-terminus.
presets.massSource: https://www.unimod.org/modifications_view.php?editid1=1 -- Unimod 1, Acetyl: monoisotopic 42.010565; site N-term, position Protein N-term
presets.formSource: https://uwpr.github.io/Comet/parameters/parameters_202602/variable_modXX.html -- the page's example variable_mod01 = 15.994915 n 0 3 0 0 0 0.0, 'oxidation of protein N-terminus': n, distance 0, terminus 0 (protein N-terminus); one per peptide, as a terminus has one

presets.name: Acetyl
presets.description: Acetylation of the protein N-terminus with Comet 2026.03.0's protein N-terminus code ^.
presets.massSource: https://www.unimod.org/modifications_view.php?editid1=1 -- Unimod 1, Acetyl: monoisotopic 42.010565; site N-term, position Protein N-term
presets.formSource: https://github.com/UWPR/Comet/blob/v2026.03.0/Comet.cpp#L996-L1003 -- comet -q's own comment above the slots: '^ = protein N-terminus only, $ = protein C-terminus only (e.g. 42.010565 ^ 0 1 -1 0 0 0.0)'

presets.name: Deamidation
presets.description: Deamidation of asparagine and glutamine (N, Q), up to three per peptide, optional.
presets.massSource: https://www.unimod.org/modifications_view.php?editid1=7 -- Unimod 7, Deamidated: monoisotopic 0.984016; sites N and Q, position Anywhere
presets.formSource: https://uwpr.github.io/Comet/parameters/parameters_202602/variable_modXX.html -- the fields of the page's first example, variable_mod01 = 15.9949 M 0 3 -1 0 0 0.0, with two residues listed as one string

presets.name: Gln->pyro-Glu
presets.description: Cyclisation of a glutamine (Q) at the peptide N-terminus to pyroglutamic acid.
presets.massSource: https://www.unimod.org/modifications_view.php?editid1=28 -- Unimod 28, Gln->pyro-Glu: monoisotopic -17.026549; site Q, position Any N-term
presets.formSource: https://uwpr.github.io/Comet/parameters/parameters_202602/variable_modXX.html -- the page's example variable_mod03 = -17.026549 Q 0 1 0 2 0 0.0, 'cyclization of N-terminal glutamine to form pyroglutamic acid'
